newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks in London seen recovering losses.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks in London seen recovering losses.

text.p: Japanese stocks recovered more than half of Friday's losses in quiet London trading on Monday.
At 1630 GMT London's Nikkei index of leading Japanese stock was up 28.18 points at 1471.49 after Japan's Nikkei 225 index closed up 327.01 points at 20,603.71.
Although dealers reported some selling in Toyota and buying in Honda, they said volume was very low, especially in the blue chip firms.
"It's been fairly dul," said one trader. "But the market is recovering from Friday. Things firmed up a lot this afternoon."
Limited buying was reported in Nippon Telegraph and Telephone which has been attracting investors since Japan said last week it planned to restructure the telecoms giant.
"We're probably going to be trading sideways from now on." said one. Another added: "We'll struggle to go much higher."
